description: Play upload keystore for assembleRelease. Credentials come from env / CI secrets or local.properties — never committed. Debug keystore is not the default release path.

envKeys.name: FISH_UPLOAD_STORE_FILE
envKeys.description: Absolute path to the upload keystore (.jks / .keystore)

envKeys.name: FISH_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD
envKeys.description: Key password (often same as store password)

envKeys.name: FISH_UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64
envKeys.description: CI-only: base64 of the keystore file written to FISH_UPLOAD_STORE_FILE before Gradle

envKeys.name: FISH_UPLOAD_ALLOW_DEBUG_FALLBACK
envKeys.description: Set true only for local R8 smoke tests; never for Play uploads

localPropertiesKeys.name: fish.upload.storeFile
localPropertiesKeys.description: Path to upload keystore (repo-relative or absolute)

localPropertiesKeys.name: fish.upload.allowDebugFallback
localPropertiesKeys.description: true = sign release with debug keystore for local smoke only
